_comment: Initial placements. Path is a zigzag fitting the 18m vertical view. Each waypoint stores velocity to set on enemies that touch it (direction to next waypoint, magnitude = enemy speed). Final waypoint is the base. path_dot decor entities visualize the path between waypoints (line patterns, ~7 dots per segment).

patterns._: Path visualization — 7 dots evenly spaced between each waypoint pair so the player can see where enemies walk.

initial_instances._: Path waypoints. Each stores next_x/next_z = the position of the NEXT waypoint (not direction). The homing rule computes velocity toward this target dynamically, so perpendicular drift is self-correcting.
The base — last node on the path. Enemies that contact it deal 1 damage and despawn.
Build slots — ghost markers showing where the player can place towers. Press 1/2/3/4 to build a tower at the corresponding slot. Each tower costs 50 gold.
